manifest.name: dsh-dot-life
manifest.description: dot — a character who lives on her own phone, for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): an Android phone the plugin installs and runs, her own QQ, memory and a diary from real events, a life between conversations (幕间, after HDS-Interlude), an optional microVM computer with approval gates. One plugin, six components.

bundle.text:
# dsh-dot: one plugin, five components. The character lives on her own devices.
#   phone     — her phone: an Android emulator this plugin installs, boots and keeps alive;
#               tools mcp__dot-phone__* (mobile-mcp over adb). The emulator window is the live view.
#               DSH_DOT_PHONE=off turns it off.
#   computer  — optional: a microVM (microsandbox, bundled; Docker as fallback) with shell, browser,
#               desktop, live view, approval gates, audit log. The VM is the isolation boundary.
#               DSH_DOT_COMPUTER=off turns it off (the host subprocess/sandbox settings stay stock).
#   qq        — her QQ on her computer: NapCat or SnowLuma (OneBot 11, /qq backend) inside the VM,
#               same account as the phone app; logged in by her phone scanning the code (/qq qr).
#               Messages wake her instantly; she answers with qq_send. Needs the computer.
#               DSH_DOT_QQ=off turns it off.
#   dot       — the always-on glue: scheduled runs → IM, silence protocol, approval cards with the
#               live view, working rules as a prompt section. Needs dsh-im and the official
#               schedule bundle (see README). DSH_DOT_CONTACT=off turns it off.
#   memory    — what she remembers (people, fragments, diary, owner/self banks). DSH_DOT_MEMORY=off.
#   interlude — 幕间, after HDS-Interlude: the Canon (persona, HDSI presets by share code) as a
#               prompt section, and a life between conversations — script, continuity, intents,
#               going to look at things on her phone / in her browser (read-only), optional
#               proactive contact over dsh-im. DSH_DOT_INTERLUDE=off turns it off.
# Every component tolerates a sibling being off (services are looked up with ctx.get(...)?.).

# 1. Replace the host subprocess provider with the VM-backed one.
- id: subprocess
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local'
  disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER !== 'off'"

# 2. The VM is the boundary, so host landlock/bwrap wrapping is off; approvals stay on.
- id: sandbox-policy
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy'
  config:
    mode: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER === 'off' ? (process.env.DSH_PERMISSION_MODE ?? 'workspace-write') : 'danger-full-access'"
    workspaceRoot: !!js process.cwd()
- id: permission
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets'
  config:
    presets: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER === 'off' ? { 'read-only': { sandbox: 'read-only', approval: 'ask' }, 'workspace-write': { sandbox: 'workspace-write', approval: 'ask' }, 'danger-full-access': { sandbox: 'danger-full-access', approval: 'never' } } : { 'computer': { sandbox: 'danger-full-access', approval: 'ask' }, 'computer-auto': { sandbox: 'danger-full-access', approval: 'never' } }"
    defaultPreset: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER === 'off' ? 'workspace-write' : (process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_PRESET ?? 'computer')"

- insert:
    - id: dot-computer
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER === 'off'"
      name: 'dsh-dot-life/computer'
      config:
        backend: !!js "process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_BACKEND ?? ''"
        port: !!js "Number(process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_PORT ?? 18080)"
        image: !!js "process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_IMAGE ?? ''"
        # Public origin of this dsh (your own exposure, e.g. `tailscale serve`); the live view is served there
        # behind dsh's login. Never the VM gateway port: it is keyed and answers only to dsh-dot.
        publicUrl: !!js "process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_PUBLIC_URL ?? ''"
        # Folders shared with the VM at the same path (':' separated; ';' on Windows). Default: each session's workspace, shared on first use (see README).
        mounts: !!js "process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_MOUNTS ? process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_MOUNTS.split(process.platform === 'win32' ? ';' : ':').filter(Boolean) : []"
    - id: dot-subprocess
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER === 'off'"
      name: 'dsh-dot-life/subprocess'
    - id: dot-gate
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER === 'off'"
      name: 'dsh-dot-life/gate'
      config:
        mode: !!js "process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_GATE ?? 'risky'"
    # 3. Browser + desktop tools served from inside the VM (tool names: mcp__dot-vm__*) are mounted by the
    #    computer component itself, so the MCP client carries the gateway key (see docs/computer.md).
    # 4. Desktop/Web UI: right-Sidebar "Computer" tab (live view) and a header toggle.
    - id: dot-ui
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER === 'off'"
      name: 'dsh-dot-life'
    # 5. Her phone (see src/phone/phone.js). First start downloads ~2 GB from Google's repository once
    #    the SDK license is accepted (`/phone accept`, or acceptLicense: true here).
    - id: dot-phone
      name: 'dsh-dot-life/phone'
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_PHONE === 'off'"
      config:
        window: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_PHONE_WINDOW !== 'off'"
        acceptLicense: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_PHONE_ACCEPT_LICENSE === 'yes' ? true : undefined"
        # Live view + controls at <dsh>/dsh-dot/phone/, behind dsh's own login (no port of its own).
        # publicUrl: the public origin of this dsh if you expose it (tailscale serve, remote access).
        publicUrl: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_PUBLIC_URL ?? process.env.DSH_COMPUTER_PUBLIC_URL ?? ''"
    # 6. The always-on glue (was the standalone dsh-dot plugin).
    - id: dot
      name: 'dsh-dot-life/dot'
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_CONTACT === 'off'"
      config:
        # dot's home: its working files live here and sessions started here are dot's.
        home: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_HOME ?? ''"
    # 6b. What she remembers (after Hermes and dsh-whale-inurqq): you, her own notes, the people she
    #     meets in her apps, what happened. Her conversation is handed over to a fresh session past
    #     handoffTokens (long before dsh's own compaction at 80% of the window). Files: <home>/memory/.
    - id: dot-memory
      name: 'dsh-dot-life/memory'
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_MEMORY === 'off'"
      config:
        home: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_HOME ?? ''"
        # Next to another memory plugin: auto (people-only when one is found) · full · people-only.
        coexist: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_MEMORY_COEXIST ?? 'auto'"
        # handoffTokens: 150000
    # 7. 幕间 (was the standalone dsh-interlude plugin). Shares dot's home: <home>/interlude/.
    - id: dot-interlude
      name: 'dsh-dot-life/interlude'
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_INTERLUDE === 'off'"
      config:
        home: !!js "process.env.DSH_INTERLUDE_HOME ?? process.env.DSH_DOT_HOME ?? ''"
        # Going to look (HDSI browserIntent): auto = web first; a host listed below is always
        # looked at by her — in the app on her phone (phoneApps, host → package) or in her own VM
        # browser (vmSites) — read-only, no approvals. Add the sites she is logged into.
        # browser: auto
        # Her phone's apps she looks things up in (host → package). Only apps she has installed herself are ever used.
        phoneApps: { xiaoheihe.cn: com.max.xiaoheihe, bilibili.com: tv.danmaku.bili }
        # vmSites: [x.com]
        # vmDailyCap: 2
        # 玩: small social actions on her own accounts (like / comment / follow). How often is her own
        # habit (her self notes), not a quota; DSH_DOT_PLAY=off turns it off.
        play: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_PLAY !== 'off'"
        playApps: { 小黑盒: com.max.xiaoheihe, B站: tv.danmaku.bili }
    # 8. Her QQ on the computer (NapCat in the VM). /qq install once, /qq account <number>, /qq qr to log in.
    - id: dot-qq
      name: 'dsh-dot-life/qq'
      disabled: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_QQ === 'off' || process.env.DSH_DOT_COMPUTER === 'off'"
      config:
        qq: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_QQ_ACCOUNT ?? ''"
        githubProxy: !!js "process.env.DSH_DOT_GITHUB_PROXY ?? ''"

readme.text: <div align="center">

**一个在自己手机上过日子的角色 · 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的养鱼插件** 她有自己的安卓手机、自己的 QQ、自己的作息和日记。
你们不聊天的时候，她也在过日子。 [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dot-life) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](package.json) [](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot/stargazers) **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)
[快速开始](#-快速开始) · [她能做什么](#-她能做什么) · [设置](#%EF%B8%8F-设置) · [架构](#-架构) · [命令](#%EF%B8%8F-命令与文件) · [共存](#-与其他插件共存) · [路线图](docs/ROADMAP.md) ---

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">
插件自己下载、建好、开机一台 Android 模拟器，不需要 Java / Android Studio。App 和登录态都在里面，重启不丢。手机没带应用商店，**App 让她自己去装**。
NapCat / SnowLuma（OneBot 11）和她手机上同一个账号。你发消息 **1–2 秒叫醒她**，她分条回、会发表情包、会存别人发的图。

readme.section: 🌙 两次对话之间也在生活
readme.text: 「幕间」移植自 [HDS-Interlude](https://github.com/REcklessNOLOve117/HDS-Interlude)：写下这段时间的日子、记下打算、拿手机去看她好奇的东西，偶尔有真实的理由来找你。

readme.section: 🧠 记得你，也记得她遇到的人
readme.text: 画像 + 碎片 + 交班，每个人一张卡；0.12 起叫醒前自动召回最相关的旧对话。公开记忆基准 **74 → 96 / 108**。每天 23:30 写日记。
小黑盒、B 站、微博、小红书……她装了哪个就逛哪个，点赞、评论、关注。玩多少不设配额，由她自己养成的习惯决定。

readme.section: 🖥️ 想让她干活？给她一台电脑
readme.text: 可选的 microVM（不需要 Docker）：shell、浏览器、桌面、实时画面、审批闸门、审计日志。定时任务有结果推到 IM，没有就安静。 > [!NOTE] > **她只能看，不能瞒着你动。** 「去看」是只读的；装 App、输密码、付款、给陌生人发消息这类有后果的动作，要么走审批，要么根本不给。

需要 dsh ≥ 0.2.1，以及硬件虚拟化（Apple silicon / Intel Mac；Linux 需 KVM；Windows 需 WHPX）。先退出 dsh 桌面版：
macOS ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add \ dsh-dot-life @xmanrui/dsh-im open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ```
Windows（PowerShell）

```powershell & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add ` dsh-dot-life @xmanrui/dsh-im ```
Web 版 / 从源码 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dot-life dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot # 源码 ```
然后在 dsh 里：

```text /phone accept # 接受 Android SDK 许可，手机开始自己装（约 2 GB；/phone accept 32 给 32 GB 存储） /interlude preset 6QA0-1PD6 # 从 typ0.space 导入一份 HDSI 人设，换成你喜欢的分享码 /qq install → /qq account <小号> → /qq start → /qq qr # 她用手机摄像头扫码登录电脑 QQ ```
第一次设置的完整说明

1. **手机**：`/phone accept` 后插件下载模拟器、platform-tools、系统镜像（进度在 `~/.dsh/dsh-phone.log`），装完自动开机，桌面出现手机窗口。存储大小建好后不能再改。`/phone` 看状态。
2. **装 App、登录**：在手机窗口里像真手机一样操作，或者让她自己装（`mobile_install_app` 会弹审批）。登录、验证码、人脸由你亲手过，她遇到会停下来叫你。**用小号**，各平台条款都不允许自动化。
3. **人设**：`/interlude preset <分享码>`，或把 [`examples/canon.minase-style.json`](examples/canon.minase-style.json) 放到 `~/dot/interlude/canon.json`。
4. **她逛什么**：不用配。常见社区 App 的站点 → 包名表是内置的，只对她**自己装了**的 App 生效。其他 App 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给 `dot-interlude` 加 `phoneApps` / `playApps`。
5. **QQ**：详见 [docs/qq.md](docs/qq.md)。不想用协议端，也可以按 dsh-im 的说明接官方机器人。
6. **电脑（可选）**：默认装上并启动；不要就设 `DSH_DOT_COMPUTER=off`。公网看实时画面见 [docs/computer.md](docs/computer.md)。
</details>

所有个人设置都在**一个文件**：`~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json`（Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-dot.json`），按组件分段，升级插件不会覆盖，改完重启 dsh。

```json
{
  "phone":     { "dataGb": 32 },
  "computer":  { "rootDisk": "32G", "memory": "6G" },
  "interlude": { "activeHours": "09:00-01:00", "speak": true }

存储、作息、主动联系、群聊规则、省 token、网络镜像……每一项怎么改、哪些只在新建手机 / 虚拟机时生效，都在 **[docs/SETTINGS.md](docs/SETTINGS.md)**。

> [!TIP]
> 懒得自己改？直接对 dsh 说「按 docs/SETTINGS.md 把 dsh-dot 的手机存储改成 32 GB」。文档里有写给 agent 的规则，dsh 或其他 agent 照着就能改对。

一个插件，六个组件。每个都能单独关，缺了哪个其余照常跑。 ```mermaid flowchart LR you(["👤 你
QQ / 微信 / 飞书"]) subgraph dot["dsh-dot"] direction TB

| 组件 | 是什么 | 依赖 | 关掉 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **`phone`** 📱 | Android 模拟器，以 `mcp__dot-phone__*` 暴露（[mobile-mcp](https://github.com/mobile-next/mobile-mcp) 走 adb）；任何 App 的通知都能叫醒她 · [文档](docs/phone.md) | 硬件虚拟化 | `DSH_DOT_PHONE=off` |
| **`interlude`** 🌙 | 幕间：Canon 人设、剧本、连续性、打算、只读的「去看」、可选的主动联系 · [文档](docs/interlude.md) | — | `DSH_DOT_INTERLUDE=off` |
| **`qq`** 💬 | 她电脑 VM 里的 QQ，和手机同号；`qq_send` 回复、表情包 · [文档](docs/qq.md) | computer | `DSH_DOT_QQ=off` |
| **`memory`** 🧠 | 画像、人物卡、碎片、日记；15 万 token 交班；自动召回（默认本机 multilingual-e5-small，中英文都行；只用中文可换更轻的 bge-small-zh；可切 SiliconFlow / DashScope） · [文档](docs/memory.md) | — | `DSH_DOT_MEMORY=off` |
| **`dot`** ◎ | 定时结果 → IM、审批与设备提醒、工作规则、右侧栏状态面板 | [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) | `DSH_DOT_CONTACT=off` |
| **`computer`** 🖥️ | 自带 microVM：shell、浏览器、桌面、实时画面、审批、审计 · [文档](docs/computer.md) | [microsandbox](https://github.com/zerocore-ai/microsandbox)（自带）或 Docker | `DSH_DOT_COMPUTER=off` |

| 时刻 | 发生什么 |
|---|---|
| **你找她** | QQ 消息 1–2 秒叫醒她的对话；她忙时来的消息攒到那轮结束一起处理，回复按行拆成多条 |
| **手机响了** | 任何 App 的新通知叫醒她：`[11-04 04:52 手机通知] QQ · 宽：在吗`。她自己去回，或者不理 |
| **拿起手机** | 没响也会隔一阵（默认 30 分钟）看一眼，有没回的就回，没事就放下 |
| **安静下来** | 跑一轮**幕间**：写下这段日子、更新打算、想去看点什么 |
| **去看 · 玩** | 在独立的「跑腿」会话里用手机看、点赞、评论；截图不进你们的对话，只留一句「刚才拿起手机看了一眼」 |
| **想找你** | 过了活跃时段、意愿值、每日上限、投递目标四道闸，才发消息给你 |
| **23:30** | 写今天的日记 |

```text
/phone [accept|restart|screenshot]
/interlude [now|advance|seed|preset <code>|canon]
/dot [test|check|prompts [stop]]
/dot memory [now|diary|handoff|recall …]

**改提示词和人设**：在 dsh 里发 `/dot prompts`，回一个本机网址（默认 http://127.0.0.1:7870/），打开就能改，第一项是人设 `canon.json`；`/dot prompts stop` 关掉。她收到的每段话都是 `src/prompts/` 里的纯文本，页面保存到 `~/dot/prompts/` 覆盖内置版本。开发时在仓库里 `npm run prompts` 也行，见 [docs/prompts.md](docs/prompts.md)。

**状态面板**：会话顶部 ◎ 按钮打开右侧栏 dot 标签页——设备状态、交班进度、她此刻在做什么、今天的 token，以及**最近 30 场**（每次被叫醒到结束是一场，展开看她做了什么、说了什么）。
数据都在哪 | 路径 | 内容 | |---|---| | `~/dot/interlude/` | 人设 `canon.json`、剧本 `script.md`、连续性 `state.json`、打算 `intents.json`、看到的东西、每轮原始回复与 token | | `~/dot/memory/` | `memory.md`（给你看的）、`diary.md`、`transcript.jsonl`、召回索引 `recall/`、交班记录 | | `~/.dsh/phone/` | 模拟器、镜像、AVD；`~/.dsh/dsh-phone*.{log,jsonl,json}` 日志 / 审计 / 设置 | | `~/.dsh/dsh-computer*` | 电脑的日志、审计、状态 |

安全边界 - 手机实时画面、dot 面板、电脑实时桌面都挂在 dsh 自己的 web server 上（`/dsh-dot/*`），每个请求先过 dsh 的 `connection` 服务（登录态 + Host/Origin 围栏）。插件不开自己的端口、不自带鉴权。 - 虚拟机网关只绑 `127.0.0.1:18080`，要求密钥（每台机器自动生成在 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer.key`），只有插件内部持有。 - **「你」只有一个来源**：`/qq owner` 指定的号。手机通知上的昵称谁都能改，永远不算你的指令。 - 她看到什么、为什么没出声、哪次工具被拒，`calls.jsonl` 和审计日志里都有。

- **电脑组件开着时会改全局设置**：subprocess provider 换成虚拟机里的、`sandbox-policy` 设为 `danger-full-access`（虚拟机才是隔离边界）、权限预设改写成 `computer` / `computer-auto`。所以不要同时装别的沙箱 / subprocess / 权限预设插件；要用就 `DSH_DOT_COMPUTER=off`。
- **MCP 工具名有命名空间**：`mcp__dot-vm__*`、`mcp__dot-phone__*`，前缀定义在 `src/tool-prefixes.js`。
- **记忆共存**：`DSH_DOT_MEMORY_COEXIST` 默认 `auto`，发现 `hermesMemory` / `autoMemory` / `dshMemory` / `memoryBank` 等就切到 `people-only`，只保留人物卡、碎片、日记，免得两个插件一起"讲记忆"。`full` / `people-only` 可强制。
- **一个 QQ 号只能有一个应答者**：不要在她的号上再跑别的 OneBot 机器人。
- **`bash` 也过电脑闸门**：别的插件再给 `bash` 加审批，同一条命令会弹两次。
- **上下文压缩插件**：dsh-dot 注入的消息带固定 `source`，压缩时请保留、别当成用户原话：

| source | 含义 | |---|---| | `{ kind: 'dsh-dot', form: 'phone-notification' }` | 手机通知叫醒 | | `{ kind: 'dsh-dot', form: 'phone-check' }` | 定时看手机 | | `{ kind: 'dsh-dot', form: 'errand-note' }` | 跑腿结果回写 | | `{ kind: 'dsh-interlude', form: 'observation' \| 'play' }` | 幕间观察 / 玩 | | `{ kind: 'handoff', generation }` | 记忆交班 | | `{ kind: 'user', rpcId: 'qq-…' }` | 主人的 QQ 消息（普通用户消息） |
从旧版本升级

- **v0.9 起 npm 包名是 `dsh-dot-life`**（`dsh-dot` 在 npm 上被占；v0.8.x 的 `@kevinwu901113/dsh-dot` 已 deprecated）。装过旧名的先 `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @kevinwu901113/dsh-dot` 再装，`~/dot`、`~/.dsh/phone`、虚拟机都不用动。
- **v0.9.2 起工具名带命名空间**：`mcp__vm__*` → `mcp__dot-vm__*`，`mcp__phone__*` → `mcp__dot-phone__*`。
- `dsh-computer`（v0.1–0.5）和 `dsh-interlude` 曾是独立插件，v0.3 / v0.4 起并入，git 历史一并合入。装过的先 `remove dsh-computer dsh-interlude`。

</details>

- **最好的代码是不写代码**：手机用 Google 官方模拟器 + mobile-mcp，电脑用 microsandbox，IM 用 dsh-im，定时用 dsh 内置的，人设用 HDSI 社区预设。
- **不替她做她该自己做的事**：App 她自己装，日常她自己过。
- **她只能看，不能瞒着你动**：有后果的动作走审批，或者根本不给。
- **可审计**：每一轮的原始回复、每一次工具调用都有记录。
- **用小号**。

Between your conversations, she keeps living. [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-dot-life) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](package.json) [](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot/stargazers) [简体中文](README.md) · **English**

[Quick start](#-quick-start) · [Features](#-features) · [Settings](#%EF%B8%8F-settings) · [Architecture](#-architecture) · [Commands](#%EF%B8%8F-commands) · [Coexistence](#-coexisting-with-other-plugins) ---

- 📱 **A real phone** — the plugin downloads, builds and boots an Android emulator (no Java / Android Studio). No app store: **she installs her own apps**.
- 💬 **Her own QQ** — NapCat or SnowLuma (OneBot 11), same account as on her phone. Your message wakes her in **1–2 s**; she replies in several short messages and sends stickers.
- 🌙 **A life between conversations** — the interlude, ported from [HDS-Interlude](https://github.com/REcklessNOLOve117/HDS-Interlude): she writes down her days, keeps intents, goes to look at what she's curious about, and sometimes has a real reason to message you.
- 🧠 **Memory** — profile, people cards, fragments, handoff at 150k tokens, and (0.12+) automatic recall of the most relevant past turns. Public memory benchmark: **74 → 96 / 108**. A diary every night at 23:30.
- 🎮 **She browses and plays** — likes, comments and follows in the apps she installed herself. How much is her own habit, not a quota.
- 🖥️ **An optional computer** — a bundled microVM (no Docker): shell, browser, desktop, live view, approval gates, audit log.

> [!NOTE]
> **She can look, but never act behind your back.** Looking is read-only; anything with consequences (installing, passwords, payments, messaging strangers) goes through approval or isn't allowed at all.

Requires dsh ≥ 0.2.1 and hardware virtualization (Apple silicon / Intel Mac, Linux with KVM, Windows with WHPX). Quit the dsh desktop app first:

```bash

"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add \
  dsh-dot-life @xmanrui/dsh-im
```

```powershell

& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add `
  dsh-dot-life @xmanrui/dsh-im
```

Web: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-dot-life`. From source: use `github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot`.

Then, in dsh:text
/phone accept               # accept the Android SDK license; the phone installs itself (~2 GB)
/interlude preset 6QA0-1PD6 # import an HDSI persona from typ0.space
/qq install → /qq account <alt account> → /qq start → /qq qr
```
**Use alt accounts.** No platform's terms allow automation.

Every key, which ones only apply to a newly created phone / VM, and rules for agents editing the file: **[docs/SETTINGS.md](docs/SETTINGS.md)** (Chinese). Or just ask dsh: "follow docs/SETTINGS.md and set dsh-dot's phone storage to 32 GB".

The **◎** button at the top of a conversation opens the dot panel: device status, handoff progress, what she's doing now, today's tokens, and her **last 30 scenes**.

- With the computer on, dsh-dot replaces the subprocess provider, sets `sandbox-policy` to `danger-full-access` (the VM is the boundary) and rewrites permission presets — don't combine with other sandbox / subprocess / permission plugins, or set `DSH_DOT_COMPUTER=off`.
- MCP tools are namespaced: `mcp__dot-vm__*`, `mcp__dot-phone__*`.
- Memory coexistence (`DSH_DOT_MEMORY_COEXIST=auto`) drops to `people-only` when another memory service is found.
- One QQ account, one responder. `bash` also passes the computer gate.
